description: Регистър на издадените разрешения за таксиметров превоз на пътници от Община Омуртаг is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Фахри Салимов. Register of taxi passenger transport permits issued by Omurtag Municipality, 2020. Coverage: Фахри Салимов. The portal shows the English title as "Register of authorisations issued for taxi transport of passengers by the Municipality of Omurtag" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Фахри Салимов. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
